desc: As an administrative staff member, I want to register patients with personal data and medical background, so that the hospital can maintain accurate and complete patient records.

alineacion.desc: As administrative staff, I want to register a new patient's data to enroll them in the system.
As administrative staff, I want to register a patient's medical background in their electronic clinical record to understand their health status.
As administrative staff, I want to register an appointment to schedule a patient's medical care.
